visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four individuals are seated in a brightly lit studio environment, arranged in a two-by-two vertical split-screen layout. Two people in the upper frame sit in black gaming chairs behind a white desk, while two in the lower frame sit similarly. The background features blue wall panels with Pac-Man graphics and shelves filled with colorful toys and merchandise. (2) The camera focus highlights a man in a floral shirt in the bottom-left frame; he gestures emphatically with his hands and displays a series of exaggerated facial expressions while looking toward his companion. Various text overlays and a pig-themed graphic appear around him during his performance. (3) The focus shifts to a man in a black jacket in the top-left frame who mimics crying, rubbing his eyes and holding his hands to his face in a dramatic fashion. His companions laugh and clap, with one man in the bottom-right frame leaning back in his chair while laughing. (4) A woman in a blue and white striped shirt in the top-right frame takes her turn to speak; she uses gentle hand movements and maintains a relatively calm but amused expression compared to the previous participants. (5) Finally, the man in the grey t-shirt in the bottom-right frame explains his scenario, using fluid hand gestures to emphasize his points. The video concludes with a graphical display showing summary scores or choices for each of the four participants.
